answer: In an agent marketplace, quill hires shale and grove only through accounts that each lock a $100 bond for 30 days and can accept at most $10 in orders daily. The quota is enforced per bonded account, not per claimed name. An attacker can create a thousand sellers, but activating them requires locking $100,000. Extra identities therefore buy no free capacity: the attacker must fund every quota and forgo other uses of that capital.
